as_told.title: Hancock on Rogan: Great Pyramid built under Khufu, subterranean part inherited

plain: The rough chamber cut into the bedrock 100 feet beneath the Great Pyramid is said to be the original sacred site at Giza, older than the pyramid above it. The researcher Graham Hancock says this to Michels as his own view. Another researcher, Luke Caverns, relays what Hancock said on the podcaster Joe Rogan's show: that most of the Great Pyramid was built under the pharaoh Khufu, but the underground level may have been inherited from an earlier time.
